_notice: DEMO DATA: Curated government schemes database matched by state and land size.

schemes.name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
schemes.benefit: ₹6,000 / year in three equal installments of ₹2,000
schemes.eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land

schemes.name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
schemes.benefit: Comprehensive crop loss coverage against non-preventable natural risks at 1.5% - 2% premium
schemes.eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.benefit: Free 12-parameter soil testing & customized dosage recommendation for macro/micro nutrients

schemes.name: Per Drop More Crop (Micro Irrigation - PMKSY)
schemes.benefit: Up to 55% subsidy for small/marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers for drip & sprinkler systems
schemes.eligibility: Farmers having assured water source and cultivable land

schemes.name: SMAM (Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization)
schemes.benefit: 40% to 50% financial assistance for procurement of agricultural machinery and equipment
schemes.eligibility: Small, marginal, SC/ST, and women farmers
